method: Each doc 07/10 statement was decomposed (by the AI research agent, unreviewed) into explicit assertions; each assertion lists regular-expression term sets that must all appear in the public title or abstract of a cited source, plus contradiction cues. 'terms_found' means the words are present, not that the abstract supports the claim; anything else is listed under mismatches for a person to read. Abstracts were read from the local cache only and are not committed.

statements.agent_reading: Consistent. The title calls the paper a 'Randomized Controlled Study Termination Report', so 'dihentikan' (stopped) is accurate; the abstract adds that of 96 eligible youths 8 expressed interest and 3 consented, and all 3 withdrew or were excluded, so no data could be evaluated. The authors offer possible reasons (perceived irrelevance of digital tools, complex protocols, privacy concerns); these are suggestions, not tested causes. Ages 12-18, Japan: one of the few register records whose accepted age range explicitly includes 15-17.
